hints.title: 2D to 1D Subarray Reduction
hints.text: Fix the left and right column boundaries to compress the 2D rectangle problem into finding a 1D continuous subarray sum at most k.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Ceiling Search
hints.text: For each 1D row sum array, compute running prefix sums. We seek previous prefix sum S such that current prefix sum minus S is at most k, or S is at least current prefix sum minus k.

hints.title: Ordered Set Binary Lookups
hints.text: Maintain ordered prefix sums seen so far. For the running prefix sum, find the smallest element greater than or equal to current prefix sum minus k. Update maximum sum found. If the maximum reaches k exactly, terminate early.

complexity.time: O(min(M, N)^2 * max(M, N) * log(max(M, N)))
complexity.notes: Prefix sums and sorted container binary search over compressed rows.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all 4 corners of rectangles takes O(M^2 * N^2) time which is too slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorted prefix sums container provides logarithmic threshold lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Compress dimension with smaller size and apply prefix sums with binary search.
